blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No player won the Grand Lotto 6/55 or Lotto 6/42 jackpots in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws Saturday, Oct. 3. According to the PCSO, the Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 11-23-36-20-29-50 for a jackpot of ₱242.63 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Lotto 6/42 winning combination was 41-17-42-21-37-02 for a jackpot of ₱75.9 million. The jackpot also had no winner.
